# Libraries

- SheetJS CE 0.20.3 — Apache-2.0; https://sheetjs.com/ ; vendored from the official CDN.
- docx — MIT; https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx ; bundled from the runtime package.
- JSZip — used under MIT; https://stuk.github.io/jszip/ ; bundled from the runtime package.

Library legal comments are retained in vendor files. No user survey data are bundled.
